name: Renewal
overview: Scripture reveals renewal as a transformative work of God in the believer's heart and spirit, calling for a clean heart and a right, constant spirit as David prays in Psalms 51. This renewal brings restoration of joy in salvation and strength to persevere, as Isaiah describes those who wait on the Lord being renewed to run without weariness. It is tied to repentance and conversion, leading to times of refreshing from the Lord’s presence, as seen in Acts. Ultimately, renewal is grounded in God's loving plan to give eternal life through faith in Christ, assuring believers of a hopeful future as promised in Jeremiah.
